40757-the-nursery-june-1881-vol-xxix-a-m.title: The Nursery June 1881 Vol Xxix A Monthly Magazine For Younge
40757-the-nursery-june-1881-vol-xxix-a-m.creator: Unknown
40757-the-nursery-june-1881-vol-xxix-a-m.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I was out in my yacht at the time. Scanning the shore with my spy-glass, this is what I saw:--  A good-looking young woman was pushing a baby-carriage before her. In the carriage was a little child. The young woman seemed to be singing, and all went well until a young man came up and walked by her side. From his dress I should say that he was a sailor. Perhaps he had just landed from a man-of-war. His trousers had the man-of-war cut.

arxiv-2211-03019.title: Hear The Flow: Optical Flow-Based Self-Supervised Visual Sound Source Localization
arxiv-2211-03019.creator: Dennis Fedorishin, Deen Dayal Mohan, Bhavin Jawade, Srirangaraj Setlur, Venu Govindaraju
arxiv-2211-03019.description: Abstract Learning to localize the sound source in videos without explicit annotations is a novel area of audio-visual research. Existing work in this area focuses on creating attention maps to capture the correlation between the two modalities to localize the source of the sound. In a video, oftentimes, the objects exhibiting movement are the ones generating the sound.

arxiv-2306-02435.title: On the complexity of linear systems: an approach via rate distortion theory and emulating systems
arxiv-2306-02435.creator: Eric Wendel, John Baillieul, and Joseph Hollmann
arxiv-2306-02435.description: Abstract We define the complexity of a continuous-time linear system to be the minimum number of bits required to describe its forward increments to a desired level of fidelity, and compute this quantity using the rate distortion function of a Gaussian source of uncertainty in those increments.

arxiv-2310-03644.title: Failure of quasi-isometric rigidity for infinite-ended groups
arxiv-2310-03644.creator: Nir Lazarovich, Emily Stark
arxiv-2310-03644.description: Abstract . We prove that an infinite-ended group whose one-ended factors have finite-index subgroups and are in a family of groups with a nonzero multiplicative invariant is not quasi-isometrically rigid. Combining this result with work of the first author proves that a residually-finite multi-ended hyperbolic group is quasi-isometrically rigid if and only if it is virtually free.

arxiv-2403-13219.title: Diffusion Model for Data-Driven Black-Box Optimization Thanks: ⋄ \diamond denotes equal contribution listed in alphabetical order. ‡ \ddagger denotes co-correspondence. Thanks: This paper is a journal version of Yuan et al. 2023 .
arxiv-2403-13219.creator: Zihao Li, Hui Yuan, Kaixuan Huang, Chengzhuo Ni, Yinyu Ye, Minshuo Chen, Mengdi Wang
arxiv-2403-13219.description: Abstract Generative AI has redefined artificial intelligence, enabling the creation of innovative content and customized solutions that drive business practices into a new era of efficiency and creativity. In this paper, we focus on diffusion models, a powerful generative AI technology, and investigate their potential for black-box optimization over complex structured variables.

arxiv-2501-03943.title: Modes, states and superselection rules in quantum optics and quantum information
arxiv-2501-03943.creator: Eloi Descamps 1, Astghik Saharyan 1, Adrien Chivet 1,2, Arne Keller 1,3, Pérola Milman 1
arxiv-2501-03943.description: Abstract A convenient way to represent quantum optical states is through the quadrature basis of single-modes of the field. This framework provides intuitive definitions for quasi-classical states, their phase-space representations, and enables the definition of a universal gate set. In this widely adopted representation of quantum optics, most pure states consist of coherent superpositions of photon-number states.

arxiv-2503-03426.title: Sharp Risk Bounds for Early-Stopping in Gaussian Linear Regression
arxiv-2503-03426.creator: Tobias Wegel, Gil Kur, Patrick Rebeschini
arxiv-2503-03426.description: Abstract We study early-stopped mirror descent (ESMD) for high-dimensional Gaussian linear regression over arbitrary convex bodies and design matrices, where the task is to minimize the in-sample mean squared error. Our main result shows that some of the sharpest risk bounds for the least squares estimator (LSE), based on the local Gaussian width, extend to ESMD.

arxiv-2503-14400.title: Nonequilibrium Statistics of Biased Kondo Resonance
arxiv-2503-14400.creator: Jong E. Han
arxiv-2503-14400.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jong E. Han. Numerical renormalization group (NRG) is formulated for nonequilibrium steady-state by converting finite-lattice many-body eigenstates into scattering states. Extension of the full-density-matrix NRG for a biased Anderson impurity model, simplified by formulating with the original orbital basis as the Hamiltonian, enables detailed studies of the sub-Kondo spectral evolution in the zero-temperature limit, confirming the double-resonance structure at bias of the Kondo energy scale T K T_{K} .

arxiv-2509-16497.title: PrediPrune: Reducing Verification Overhead in Souper with Machine Learning–Driven Pruning CCS: Software and its engineering Compilers CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning
arxiv-2509-16497.creator: Ange-Thierry Ishimwe, Heewoo Kim, Tamara Lehman, Joseph Izraelevitz, Raghuveer Shivakumar
arxiv-2509-16497.description: Abstract . Souper is a powerful enumerative superoptimizer that enhances the runtime performance of programs by optimizing LLVM intermediate representation (IR) code. However, its verification process, which relies on a computationally expensive SMT solver to validate optimization candidates, must explore a large search space.

doe-osti-3020632-advanced-conductor-test.creator: Bell, Crash, Neumann, Abby M.
doe-osti-3020632-advanced-conductor-test.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This is the results of advanced conductor testing in report form. This report demonstrates the characteristics of the Southwire C7 TP conductor when exposed to wildfire conditions.

pmc-10702545.title: Linking Mesoscale Spatial Variation in Methylmercury Production to Bioaccumulation in Tidal Marsh Food Webs
pmc-10702545.creator: Laurie A Hall, Isa Woo, Mark Marvin-DiPasquale, John Y Takekawa, David P Krabbenhoft, Donald Yee, Letitia Grenier, Susan E W De La Cruz
pmc-10702545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Differences in sediment biogeochemistry among tidal marsh features with different hydrological and geomorphological characteristics, including marsh interiors, marsh edges, first-order channels, and third-order channels, can result in spatial variation in MeHg production and availability. To better understand the link between MeHg production in sediments and bioaccumulation in primary and secondary consumer invertebrates and fish, we characterized mesoscale spatial variation in sediment biogeochemistry and MeHg concentrations of sediments, water, and consumer tissues among marsh features.

pmc-11332929.title: “I was given PrEP, but had no privacy”: Mystery shopper perspectives of PrEP counseling for adolescent girls and young women in Kisumu County, Kenya
pmc-11332929.creator: Melissa Vera, Helen Aketch, Caroline Omom, Felix Otieno, George Owiti, Joseph Sila, John Kinuthia, Kristin Beima-Sofie, Jillian Pintye, Valarie Kemunto, Eunita Akim, Grace John-Stewart, Pamela Kohler, Matt A Price, Matt A Price, Matt A Price
pmc-11332929.description: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is being scaled up to prevent HIV acquisition among adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) in Eastern and Southern Africa. In a prior study more than one-third of AGYW ‘mystery shoppers’ stated they would not return to care based on interactions with health providers.

pmc-11426415.title: Understanding Macrophage Complexity in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: Transitioning from the M1/M2 Paradigm to Spatial Dynamics
pmc-11426415.creator: Forkan Ahamed, Natalie Eppler, Elizabeth Jones, Yuxia Zhang
pmc-11426415.description: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) encompasses metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver (MASL) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), with MASH posing a risk of progression to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The global prevalence of MASLD is estimated at approximately a quarter of the population, with significant healthcare costs and implications for liver transplantation.

pmc-11507484.title: Demographics, Clinical Characteristics, and Well-Being of Veterans with TBI and Dementia and Their Caregivers
pmc-11507484.creator: Linda O Nichols, Jennifer Martindale-Adams, Ronald T Seel, Jeffrey K Zuber, Paul B Perrin, Phyo Kyaw Myint, Staffan Karlsson
pmc-11507484.description: Background: This study provides a detailed examination of older Veterans with traumatic brain injury (TBI) and dementia and their caregivers, focusing on Veterans’ demographic, clinical, functional, safety risk, and behavioral characteristics and caregivers’ demographic, clinical, and care-related characteristics and well-being. Methods: Veterans’ caregivers (N = 110) completed a telephone-based survey.

pmc-11530587.title: Survival outcomes of young-age female patients with early breast cancer: an international multicenter cohort study
pmc-11530587.creator: J Kim, J Kim, KH Seo, K-H Lee, YH Park, C-H Lin, Y-S Lu, T Ueno, Y-S Yap, F-Y Wong, VKM Tan, G-H Lim, S-M Tan, W Yeo, Q Liu, R Leung, Y Naito, H Li, H-B Lee, W Han, S-A Im, Asian Breast Cancer Cooperative Group
pmc-11530587.description: BackgroundThe incidence of breast cancer among young Asian women is increasing, yet they remain underrepresented in global data. We analyzed the epidemiology and outcomes of Asian patients with breast cancer <40 years old across different subtypes to identify their clinical unmet needs.

pmc-11532031.title: A cross-sectional study of evidence-based practice and its determinants among healthcare professionals in Northwest Ethiopia
pmc-11532031.creator: Yideg Melkamu, Mulusew Andualem Asemahagn, Ayinengida Adamu Walle, Yawkal Tsega
pmc-11532031.description: BackgroundEvidence-based practice (EBP) is the integration of current best evidence with clinical expertise by considering patient preferences and values. Evidence based practice has not been well studied in Ethiopia. Therefore, this study aimed to assess EBP and its determinants among health professionals working at primary public hospitals in the Central Gondar zone, Northwest Ethiopia.

pmc-12576982.title: Risk prediction of cardiometabolic diseases with depression in the community of Xinjiang production and construction corps
pmc-12576982.creator: Ziqi Wang, Jinhe Fan, Jianing Fan, Mingxia Jing
pmc-12576982.description: ObjectiveDepression not only diminishes the quality of life and self-care abilities of the elderly but also exacerbates the burden of pre-existing physical diseases. This study aims to explore the influencing factors of depressive events in patients with cardiometabolic disease (CMD) within a division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps (XPCC).

pmc-12639906.title: Novel gp60 subtypes and genetic diversity of Cryptosporidium felis in domestic and stray cats from Central Europe
pmc-12639906.creator: Veronika Zikmundová, Eliška Höflerová, Nikola Holubová, Marta Kicia, Matúš Rajský, Pavel Beran, Bohumil Sak, Martin Kváč
pmc-12639906.description: BackgroundCryptosporidium felis, a host-specific protozoan with possible zoonotic potential, is a common parasite of cats (Felis catus). To date, there have been few studies on the molecular subtyping of C. felis worldwide, and no have been conducted in Central Europe. The aim of this study was to analyse the prevalence and genetic variability of C.

pmc-12751392.title: Clinical characteristics and prognostic impact of HER2-ultralow breast cancer and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs)
pmc-12751392.creator: Koji Takada, Shinichiro Kashiwagi, Mariko Nishikawa, Asuka Kochi, Chika Watanabe, Haruhito Kinoshita, Kana Ogisawa, Masatsune Shibutani, Tamami Morisaki
pmc-12751392.description: PurposeHER2 expression is crucial in breast cancer classification and treatment. Traditionally, tumors were categorized as HER2-positive or HER2-negative, but HER2-low (IHC 1 + or 2 + without ISH amplification) has emerged as a new classification. Among HER2-negative cases, HER2-ultralow (≤ 10% faint HER2 staining) and HER2-null (completely HER2-negative) have been proposed.

pmc-12988107.title: Regional-specific GABAergic imbalance in cisplatin-induced neuropathy and antiallodynic effects of intraplantar baclofen in rats
pmc-12988107.creator: Yingshi Quan, Enji Zhang, Yongshan Nan, Hai Lin
pmc-12988107.description: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) is a debilitating complication of cisplatin chemotherapy, often manifesting as mechanical allodynia, which frequently resists conventional treatments. This study explored the behavioral and molecular alterations induced by cisplatin, with a focus on regional dysfunction of the gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) system, and evaluated the therapeutic potential of intraplantar baclofen (a GABAB receptor agonist) in alleviating CIPN.

pmc-13062682.title: Gravity-sensing device for measuring bending angles in digestive endoscopes: Design and clinical evaluation
pmc-13062682.creator: Ming-yan Luo, Li-qiu Liu, Zhao-xia Lun, Chao-yuan Huang, Xu-chao Chen, Yuan Huang, Zhao-li Fu, Chang-kun Zhou, Hua Yang, Wang Zhang
pmc-13062682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We developed a novel, gravity-sensing device to measure bending angles of digestive endoscopes, addressing inefficiency and inaccuracy of traditional planar measurement cards. This single-operator tool utilizes a freely rolling ball bearing within a calibrated ring to quantify angles. A multicenter instrument comparison demonstrated that the device significantly improved measurement efficiency and consistency while reducing associated maintenance costs, offering a practical solution for endoscopy unit quality control.

pmc-13352705.title: Methodological estimation of pore size in hen eggshell membranes
pmc-13352705.creator: Masahide Hagiri, Mayuko Suzuki
pmc-13352705.description: ObjectiveEggshell membranes (ESM) are proteinaceous biobarriers critical to avian embryonic development and microbial exclusion. Despite their importance, quantitative assessments of ESM pore dimensions remain limited. This study aimed to determine the effective pore size of chicken ESM and to validate methodological approaches for its estimation.ResultsTwo orthogonal strategies were employed to evaluate ESM pore architecture.

pmc-13434142.title: Cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric validation of the Arabic version of the Orofacial Awakening Symptoms Questionnaire (OFASQ)
pmc-13434142.creator: Christelle Haddad, Ziad Azar, Anthony Mathias, Lynn Fayad, Tia Azar, Tylor Cosgrove, Mirna Fawaz, Sahar Obeid, Feten Fekih-Romdhane, Souheil Hallit
pmc-13434142.description: Background: Making a measure of orofacial pain available for use among Arabic-speakers might contribute to the development of prevention and therapeutic programs that consider psychosocial and behavioral determinants of the Lebanese population. This study aimed to translate, culturally adapt, and validate the Arabic version of the Orofacial Awakening Symptoms Questionnaire (OFASQ) among Lebanese adults.
